events.title_en: Holy spirit poured out on about 120 disciples at Pentecost
events.description_en: On the Festival of Weeks (Pentecost), Sivan 6 of 33 C.E., holy spirit was poured out by the resurrected Jesus on about 120 disciples gathered in an upper room in Jerusalem. Pentecost fell on the 50th day counted from Nisan 16, the day of Jesus’ resurrection.
events.description_ta: சீவான் 6, பெந்தெகொஸ்தே: ஆவி ஊற்றப்படுகிறது; யூதர்கள் கிறிஸ்தவர்களாவதற்கு பேதுரு வழியைத் திறந்தார்

events.description_en: The same Pentecost day, Peter preached to the crowds gathered in Jerusalem for the festival, and about 3,000 persons were baptized and added to the disciples. si Study 3 describes this as Peter opening the way for Jews to enter the Christian congregation.
